subject: Taxes
title: The Pain of Tax Day
description: A quick win: understand The Pain of Tax Day.

hook.text: Fatal car accidents spike by 6% on US Tax Day. The stress of filing literally kills people—not the money, the process.

buildup.text: Researchers at UC San Diego analyzed 30 years of accident data.

discovery.text: Tax filing anxiety causes distraction, rushed driving, and emotional distress.

twist.text: Countries with pre-filled returns—like Sweden and Japan—have no such spike. The stress isn't about taxes.

climax.text: The complexity of tax filing is a public health issue.

punchline.text: 6% more fatal accidents on Tax Day. Complexity kills, literally.

quiz.question: What causes the spike in car accidents on Tax Day?
options: People driving to the post office
Cognitive overload and stress from filing taxes
